purpose_en: A natural-farming botanical pesticide used mainly against large pests such as caterpillars and larvae.
purpose_ta: கம்பளிப்புழு, புழுக்கள் போன்ற பெரிய பூச்சிகளுக்கு எதிராகப் பயன்படும் இயற்கை வேளாண் தாவரப் பூச்சிவிரட்டி.

key_points: Ingredients: 20 litres of desi cow urine plus 2 kg each of any five leaf pastes (neem, karanj, custard apple, castor, dhatura, bael)
Heat on a low flame until it boils, then cool; stir twice daily for two days and filter through cloth
"6 to 8 liters of Brahmastra should be mixed with 100 to 200 liters of water per acre and sprayed on crops."
Can be stored for up to 6 months

source_organization: District Administration Anand, Government of Gujarat
document_reference: Highly Effective Chemical-Free Pesticide in Natural Farming – 'Brahmastra'
